metadata.title: High-Contrast Portrait with Sinuous Graphic Overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, black-and-white portrait of a man in a dark sweater, bisected vertically by a metallic, serpentine sculptural element, featuring blue and white serif typography across the lower third.
coreVisualRelationships: The metallic curve creates a visual barrier and path between the subject and the viewer.
The dark silhouette of the subject anchors the bottom half against a stark white background.
The blue typography provides a singular color pop against the monochromatic palette.
The verticality of the sculpture contrasts with the horizontal alignment of the text.
coreInvariants: Deep shadows on the subject's clothing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame with a medium close-up crop.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, framed by the dark hair and sweater, serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the metallic curve from the top edge down through the center, landing on the horizontal text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white negative space in the upper right and left corners creates a clean, airy feel despite the heavy blacks.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and white photography for the subject and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the sweater and hair against a pure white background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted cornflower blue for the primary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low saturation, except for the single blue accent.

letterConstructionRules: Primary name in wide-tracked, elegant serifs
Secondary name in condensed, high-contrast serifs
Subtitle in lowercase, widely spaced italics
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard font geometry and tracking adjustments.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between wide-tracked classical serifs and tightly packed condensed serifs.

preserve: Wide tracking of the first name
Blue color for the main text
avoid: Sans-serif fonts for the main names

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the classical, wide-tracked serif look for the first name.
Matches the high-contrast, vertical feel of the second name.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of a man in a black sweater against a white background. Overlay a single, 3D metallic silver winding 'S' curve that starts at the top and winds down the center of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in wide-tracked blue serif font across the lower left. Add the secondary name in condensed blue serif font on the lower right. Add a small italicized subtitle below the second name.

verificationChecks: Is the metallic curve centered and winding?
Is the photography strictly high-contrast monochrome?
Is the text blue and using serif fonts?
Is there a thin black border around the entire composition?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of blue for typography
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast black levels in the sweater.
Ensure the metallic curve has a realistic 3D sheen.
Verify the blue text is legible against both black and white areas.
Confirm the composition feels asymmetrical but balanced.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast portrait + Sinuous metallic overlay + Wide-tracked serif typography in accent color.
